## Feature 5 — Lifecycle Controller

```/dev/null/LifecycleObserver.kt#L1-40
// app/SentryLifecycleObserver.kt

class SentryLifecycleObserver @Inject constructor(
    private val locationService: LocationService,
    private val hardwareChecker: HardwareChecker,
) : DefaultLifecycleObserver {

    override fun onResume(owner: LifecycleOwner) {
        locationService.startTracking()     // resume GPS
        hardwareChecker.startPolling()      // refresh hardware state
    }

    override fun onPause(owner: LifecycleOwner) {
        locationService.stopTracking()      // save battery, persist last known location
        hardwareChecker.stopPolling()
    }

    override fun onStop(owner: LifecycleOwner) {
        // Enqueue upload if connectivity allows — handles backgrounding
        UploadManager.requestUpload()
    }
}
```

Registered in `MainActivity` via `lifecycle.addObserver(sentryLifecycleObserver)`. The `ViewModel` uses `SavedStateHandle` to survive process death, preserving the current sighting draft.

## Q07 — Offline-First Repository (Single Source of Truth)

```/dev/null/OfflineFirstSightingRepository.kt#L1-55
// core/data/repository/OfflineFirstSightingRepository.kt

class OfflineFirstSightingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val sightingDao: SightingDao,
    private val remoteApi: SentryRemoteApi,
    private val rangerSession: RangerSession,
) : SightingRepository {

    // UI always reads from Room — never from network
    override fun getSightings(): Flow<List<Sighting>> =
        sightingDao.getSightingsForRanger(rangerSession.currentRangerId!!)
            .map { entities -> entities.map(SightingEntity::asDomainModel) }

    // Write locally first, enqueue upload → Room Flow updates UI immediately
    override suspend fun logSighting(sighting: Sighting) {
        val entity = sighting.asEntity(
            rangerId = rangerSession.currentRangerId!!,
            synced = false,
        )
        sightingDao.upsertSighting(entity)
        // Room emits update → UI refreshes automatically
        // Upload happens later via WorkManager when constraints are met
    }

    // Sync: server → local Room (for shared sightings from other rangers)
    override suspend fun syncWith(synchronizer: Synchronizer): Boolean =
        synchronizer.changeListSync(
            versionReader = ChangeListVersions::sightingVersion,
            changeListFetcher = { version -> remoteApi.getSightingChangeList(after = version) },
            versionUpdater = { latestVersion -> copy(sightingVersion = latestVersion) },
            modelDeleter = { ids -> sightingDao.deleteSightingsByIds(ids) },
            modelUpdater = { ids ->
                val remoteSightings = remoteApi.getSightings(ids = ids)
                sightingDao.upsertSightings(remoteSightings.map { it.asEntity(synced = true) })
            },
        )
}
```

The rule is identical to NowInAndroid: **Room is the single source of truth. The repository writes to Room; the UI observes Room via Flow.** After a sync, Room emits automatically. The UI never touches a network response directly.

## Q08 — Background Connectivity → Auto-Upload Trigger

```/dev/null/ConnectivityUploadTrigger.kt#L1-45
// core/data/util/ConnectivityUploadTrigger.kt

@Singleton
class ConnectivityUploadTrigger @Inject constructor(
    private val networkMonitor: NetworkMonitor,
    private val uploadManager: UploadManager,
    private val appScope: CoroutineScope,  // application-level scope
) {
    // Call from Application.onCreate()
    fun initialize() {
        appScope.launch {
            networkMonitor.networkState
                .distinctUntilChanged()
                .collect { state ->
                    if (state == NetworkState.CONNECTED) {
                        // Transition from offline → online: enqueue upload
                        uploadManager.requestUpload()
                    }
                }
        }
    }
}
```

`NetworkCallback.onAvailable()` fires → `networkState` emits `CONNECTED` → WorkManager upload request is enqueued. No polling. The `ConnectivityManager` callback is registered once for the app lifetime via the application-scoped coroutine. It unregisters automatically when the app process dies.

## Q09 — Multi-Ranger Data Isolation

```/dev/null/MultiRanger.kt#L1-50
// All DAO queries are ALWAYS scoped by ranger_id — NEVER unscoped

@Entity(tableName = "rangers")
data class RangerEntity(
    @PrimaryKey @ColumnInfo(name = "ranger_id") val rangerId: String,
    val username: String,
    val pinHash: String,   // bcrypt hash — never store plain PIN
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "sightings",
    foreignKeys = [ForeignKey(entity = RangerEntity::class,
        parentColumns = ["ranger_id"], childColumns = ["ranger_id"],
        onDelete = ForeignKey.RESTRICT)]
)
data class SightingEntity(
    @PrimaryKey val id: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "ranger_id") val rangerId: String,  // isolation key
    ...
)

// RangerSession — single source of logged-in ranger
@Singleton
class RangerSession @Inject constructor(
    private val dataStore: DataStore<RangerPreferences>
) {
    val currentRangerId: Flow<String?> = dataStore.data.map { it.activeRangerId.ifEmpty { null } }

    suspend fun login(rangerId: String) = dataStore.updateData { it.copy { activeRangerId = rangerId } }
    suspend fun logout() = dataStore.updateData { it.copy { activeRangerId = "" } }
}

// DAO — always parameterized
@Query("SELECT * FROM sightings WHERE ranger_id = :rangerId ORDER BY recorded_at DESC")
fun getSightingsForRanger(rangerId: String): Flow<List<SightingEntity>>

// File storage — per-ranger directory
val rangerPhotoDir = File(context.filesDir, "photos/$rangerId/")
rangerPhotoDir.mkdirs()
```

**Critical rule:** The `rangerId` comes from the session, not from user input. Every query, every file path, every DataStore key is scoped to the logged-in `rangerId`. There is no global "get all sightings" query in any DAO — it would be a security violation.

## Complete Data Flow Diagram

```/dev/null/dataflow.txt#L1-30
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                          UI Layer (Compose)                          │
│   Screen ← StateFlow ← ViewModel ← Repository ← Room DAO ← Flow    │
└───────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
                                │ User action
                                ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        Repository (Offline-First)                    │
│   1. Write to Room immediately  (sighting logged offline)            │
│   2. Room Flow emits → UI updates instantly                          │
│   3. Mark synced=false                                               │
└───────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
                                │ WorkManager (when online + battery OK)
                                ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     SightingUploadWorker                             │
│   1. Fetch unsynced records  (synced=false, ranger_id scoped)        │
│   2. Batch upload (50/batch) with UUID idempotency key               │
│   3. On success: markAsSynced() → Room emits update                  │
│   4. On failure: Result.retry() → exponential backoff                │
└───────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
                                │
                                ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│               Remote Server (Firestore / REST API)                   │
│   Publishes FCM topic message → all ranger devices notified          │
│   → SentryMessagingService.onMessageReceived() → WorkManager sync    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Critical Design Rules (Learned from NowInAndroid)

| Rule | NowInAndroid Evidence | SilverBack Sentry Application |
|---|---|---|
| **Room = single source of truth** | `OfflineFirstNewsRepository` reads only from DAO | `OfflineFirstSightingRepository` reads only from DAO |
| **Never destructive migration** | 14 versions, all `AutoMigration` or `addMigrations()` | `addMigrations()` for every version bump |
| **No polling for connectivity** | `callbackFlow` + `NetworkCallback` | Same pattern, triggers upload on `onAvailable()` |
| **FCM = background wake-up only** | `SyncNotificationsService` → `requestSync()` | `SentryMessagingService` → `requestUpload()` |
| **Unique work, keep policy** | `enqueueUniqueWork(KEEP)` prevents duplicate syncs | Same — one upload job at a time |
| **Ranger ID in every query** | N/A (single user) | **Every DAO method parameterized by `ranger_id`** |
| **Client-side UUID** | `id: String` primary key | UUID generated at log time — idempotent uploads |
| **`synced` flag for upload tracking** | N/A (server is source of truth for NiA) | `synced: Boolean` + `syncAttempt: Int` per record |
| **`WhileSubscribed(5_000)` on StateFlow** | All ViewModels | All SilverBack ViewModels |
| **`awaitClose` on callbacks** | `ConnectivityManagerNetworkMonitor` | Hardware checker, network monitor |
| **Batch network calls** | `chunked(SYNC_BATCH_SIZE)` = 40 | `chunked(50)` for upload batches |

This architecture is **fail-proof for field use** because: data is never lost (write-local-first), network transitions are detected without battery drain (no polling), migrations preserve weeks of unsynced ranger data, and multi-ranger isolation is enforced at the database query level — not at the application logic level where it can be accidentally bypassed.

```nowinandroid/core/common/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/core/common/result/Result.kt
package com.google.samples.apps.nowinandroid.core.common.result

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.catch
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.onStart

sealed interface Result<out T> {
    data class Success<T>(val data: T) : Result<T>
    data class Error(val exception: Throwable) : Result<Nothing>
    data object Loading : Result<Nothing>
}

fun <T> Flow<T>.asResult(): Flow<Result<T>> = map<T, Result<T>> { Result.Success(it) }
    .onStart { emit(Result.Loading) }
    .catch { emit(Result.Error(it)) }
```

# SilverBack Sentry — Complete Java Architecture

## Key Translation Table: Kotlin → Java

| NowInAndroid (Kotlin) | SilverBack Sentry (Java) |
|---|---|
| `Flow<T>` from DAO | `LiveData<T>` from DAO |
| `StateFlow<T>` in ViewModel | `MutableLiveData<T>` in ViewModel |
| `callbackFlow { awaitClose {} }` | Custom `LiveData` subclass using `onActive()` / `onInactive()` |
| `suspend fun` | `void` + `ExecutorService` background thread |
| `CoroutineWorker` | `Worker` (sync, WorkManager runs it on background thread) |
| `data class` | Java POJO with final fields + constructor |
| `sealed class Result` | Abstract `DataResult<T>` + static subclasses |
| `object` Singleton | `@Singleton` + Hilt `@Provides` |
| Extension functions | `static` utility methods |
| `Transformations.switchMap` | `MediatorLiveData` |
| `@HiltWorker + @AssistedInject` | `@EntryPoint` accessed in Worker constructor |
| Proto DataStore | `SharedPreferences` |

```/dev/null/Sighting.java#L1-52
        this.latitude     = latitude;
```

```/dev/null/DataResult.java#L1-45
// core/model/DataResult.java  (replaces Kotlin sealed Result)
package com.silverbacksentry.core.model;

/** Mirrors NowInAndroid's sealed Result<T> but in plain Java. */
public abstract class DataResult<T> {

    private DataResult() {} // prevent external subclassing

    // ── Success ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public static final class Success<T> extends DataResult<T> {
        public final T data;
        public Success(T data) { this.data = data; }
    }

    // ── Error ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public static final class Error<T> extends DataResult<T> {
        public final Throwable exception;
        public Error(Throwable exception) { this.exception = exception; }
    }

    // ── Loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public static final class Loading<T> extends DataResult<T> {}

    // ── Factory helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public static <T> Success<T> success(T data)         { return new Success<>(data); }
    public static <T> Error<T>   error(Throwable t)      { return new Error<>(t);     }
    public static <T> Loading<T> loading()               { return new Loading<>();    }

    // ── Type checks (replaces Kotlin `is Success`) ────────────────────────────
    public boolean isSuccess() { return this instanceof Success; }
    public boolean isError()   { return this instanceof Error;   }
    public boolean isLoading() { return this instanceof Loading; }
}
```

```/dev/null/DateConverter.java#L1-22
package com.silverbacksentry.core.database.util;

import androidx.room.TypeConverter;
import java.util.Date;

public final class DateConverter {

    @TypeConverter
    public static Long dateToTimestamp(Date date) {
        return (date == null) ? null : date.getTime();
    }

    @TypeConverter
    public static Date fromTimestamp(Long value) {
        return (value == null) ? null : new Date(value);
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/SightingEntity.java#L1-82
// core/database/model/SightingEntity.java
package com.silverbacksentry.core.database.model;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
import androidx.room.ColumnInfo;
import androidx.room.Entity;
import androidx.room.ForeignKey;
import androidx.room.Index;
import androidx.room.PrimaryKey;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.HealthStatus;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.Sighting;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Q01 — Room entity.
 * ForeignKey to rangers: RESTRICT on delete so ranger accounts cannot be erased
 * while they carry unsynced sightings.
 * Indexed on ranger_id, synced, recorded_at for fast offline queries.
 */
@Entity(
    tableName = "sightings",
    foreignKeys = {
        @ForeignKey(
            entity    = RangerEntity.class,
            parentColumns = {"ranger_id"},
            childColumns  = {"ranger_id"},
            onDelete  = ForeignKey.RESTRICT   // ← never CASCADE on sightings
        )
    },
    indices = {
        @Index("ranger_id"),
        @Index("synced"),
        @Index("recorded_at")
    }
)
public class SightingEntity {

    @PrimaryKey
    @NonNull
    public String id;                          // UUID, generated on the device

    @NonNull
    @ColumnInfo(name = "ranger_id")
    public String rangerId;                    // Q09 isolation key

    @Nullable
    @ColumnInfo(name = "gorilla_id")
    public String gorillaId;

    public double latitude;
    public double longitude;

    @ColumnInfo(name = "group_size")
    public int groupSize;

    @ColumnInfo(name = "health_status")
    public HealthStatus healthStatus;          // stored as TEXT via converter

    @NonNull
    public String notes;

    @ColumnInfo(name = "recorded_at")
    public Date recordedAt;

    public boolean synced = false;             // false until server ACKs upload

    @ColumnInfo(name = "sync_attempt")
    public int syncAttempt = 0;               // incremented on each retry

    // ── Domain ↔ Entity helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    public static SightingEntity fromDomain(Sighting s) {
        SightingEntity e = new SightingEntity();
        e.id           = s.id;
        e.rangerId     = s.rangerId;
        e.gorillaId    = s.gorillaId;
        e.latitude     = s.latitude;
        e.longitude    = s.longitude;
        e.groupSize    = s.groupSize;
        e.healthStatus = s.healthStatus;
        e.notes        = s.notes;
        e.recordedAt   = s.recordedAt;
        e.synced       = s.synced;
        return e;
    }

    public Sighting toDomain() {
        return new Sighting(id, rangerId, gorillaId, latitude, longitude,
                            groupSize, healthStatus, notes, recordedAt, synced);
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/SightingDao.java#L1-65
// core/database/dao/SightingDao.java
package com.silverbacksentry.core.database.dao;

import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
import androidx.room.Dao;
import androidx.room.Query;
import androidx.room.Transaction;
import androidx.room.Upsert;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.model.SightingEntity;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Q01 — Full CRUD DAO.
 * Every query is scoped by ranger_id (Q09 — data isolation).
 * Methods returning LiveData are reactive — Room emits a new list
 * whenever the underlying table changes (single source of truth, Q07).
 * Methods returning List are blocking — call only from background threads.
 */
@Dao
public interface SightingDao {

    // ── CREATE / UPDATE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** Upsert: INSERT OR REPLACE without discarding existing rows */
    @Upsert
    void upsertSighting(SightingEntity sighting);

    @Upsert
    void upsertSightings(List<SightingEntity> sightings);

    // ── READ — reactive (LiveData) ────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** UI observes this — Room pushes updates automatically after any write */
    @Query("SELECT * FROM sightings WHERE ranger_id = :rangerId " +
           "ORDER BY recorded_at DESC")
    LiveData<List<SightingEntity>> getSightingsForRanger(String rangerId);

    @Query("SELECT * FROM sightings WHERE id = :id AND ranger_id = :rangerId LIMIT 1")
    LiveData<SightingEntity> getSightingById(String id, String rangerId);

    // ── READ — blocking (for use inside Workers / Executors) ─────────────────

    /** Called from Worker.doWork() — already on a background thread */
    @Query("SELECT * FROM sightings WHERE synced = 0 AND ranger_id = :rangerId " +
           "ORDER BY recorded_at ASC")
    List<SightingEntity> getUnsyncedSightingsSync(String rangerId);

    @Query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sightings WHERE synced = 0 AND ranger_id = :rangerId")
    int getUnsyncedCountSync(String rangerId);

    // ── UPDATE — mark as synced after successful upload ───────────────────────

    @Query("UPDATE sightings SET synced = 1 WHERE id IN (:ids)")
    void markAsSynced(List<String> ids);

    @Query("UPDATE sightings SET sync_attempt = sync_attempt + 1 WHERE id IN (:ids)")
    void incrementSyncAttempt(List<String> ids);

    // ── DELETE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Query("DELETE FROM sightings WHERE id = :id AND ranger_id = :rangerId")
    void deleteSighting(String id, String rangerId);

    @Query("DELETE FROM sightings WHERE id IN (:ids)")
    void deleteSightingsByIds(List<String> ids);

    @Query("DELETE FROM sightings WHERE ranger_id = :rangerId")
    void deleteAllForRanger(String rangerId);
}
```

```/dev/null/SentryDatabase.java#L1-55
package com.silverbacksentry.core.database;

import androidx.room.AutoMigration;
import androidx.room.Database;
import androidx.room.RoomDatabase;
import androidx.room.TypeConverters;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.dao.RangerDao;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.dao.SightingDao;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.dao.SightingPhotoDao;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.model.RangerEntity;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.model.SightingEntity;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.model.SightingPhotoEntity;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.util.DateConverter;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.util.HealthStatusConverter;

/**
 * Q01 — Main Room database.
 *
 * exportSchema = true  → Room writes schema JSON to schemas/ folder.
 *   These JSON snapshots are committed to git and compared at compile
 *   time — Room will fail the build if a migration is missing.
 *
 * autoMigrations — declared here for simple column additions.
 *   For renames/deletes, write a DatabaseMigrations.SchemaXtoY spec class.
 *
 * NEVER use fallbackToDestructiveMigration() — rangers carry weeks of
 * unsynced sightings. Destructive migration = unrecoverable data loss.
 */
@Database(
    entities = {
        RangerEntity.class,
        SightingEntity.class,
        SightingPhotoEntity.class
    },
    version = 1,
    exportSchema = true,
    autoMigrations = {
        // uncomment as schema evolves:
        // @AutoMigration(from = 1, to = 2),
        // @AutoMigration(from = 2, to = 3, spec = DatabaseMigrations.Schema2to3.class)
    }
)
@TypeConverters({DateConverter.class, HealthStatusConverter.class})
public abstract class SentryDatabase extends RoomDatabase {

    public abstract RangerDao      rangerDao();
    public abstract SightingDao    sightingDao();
    public abstract SightingPhotoDao sightingPhotoDao();
}
```

### 3e. Migrations — Zero Data Loss Strategy

```/dev/null/DatabaseMigrations.java#L1-70
// core/database/DatabaseMigrations.java
package com.silverbacksentry.core.database;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.room.DeleteColumn;
import androidx.room.RenameColumn;
import androidx.room.migration.AutoMigrationSpec;
import androidx.room.migration.Migration;
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase;

/**
 * Q01 — All schema migrations live here.
 *
 * Two strategies:
 *
 *  1. AutoMigration (simple — column add with default, table rename):
 *     → Declare in @Database(autoMigrations = {...})
 *     → Provide a spec class below when Room cannot infer the change alone.
 *
 *  2. Manual Migration (complex — data transform, composite changes):
 *     → Write a Migration object and register via addMigrations() in
 *       DatabaseModule.  Room runs migrate() inside a transaction.
 *
 * Field rangers carry weeks of offline data.
 * fallbackToDestructiveMigration() is FORBIDDEN in this project.
 */
public final class DatabaseMigrations {

    private DatabaseMigrations() {}   // utility class

    // ── AutoMigration specs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Example: version 2 renames "notes" → "ranger_notes" in sightings.
     * Declare in @Database: @AutoMigration(from = 1, to = 2, spec = Schema1to2.class)
     */
    @RenameColumn(tableName = "sightings",
                  fromColumnName = "notes",
                  toColumnName   = "ranger_notes")
    public static class Schema1to2 implements AutoMigrationSpec {}

    /**
     * Example: version 3 drops a deprecated column.
     */
    @DeleteColumn(tableName = "sightings", columnName = "deprecated_field")
    public static class Schema2to3 implements AutoMigrationSpec {}

    // ── Manual migrations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Example of a complex manual migration:
     * Adds a new "vegetation_density" column that cannot be null and needs
     * a meaningful default (Room AutoMigration only supports '' or 0 defaults).
     *
     * Register in DatabaseModule:
     *   .addMigrations(DatabaseMigrations.MIGRATION_3_4)
     */
    public static final Migration MIGRATION_3_4 = new Migration(3, 4) {
        @Override
        public void migrate(@NonNull SupportSQLiteDatabase db) {
            // Always run DDL inside the provided transaction
            db.execSQL(
                "ALTER TABLE sightings " +
                "ADD COLUMN vegetation_density TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium'"
            );
        }
    };

    /**
     * Data-backfill migration example:
     * Splits a "location" TEXT column into separate lat/lng columns.
     */
    public static final Migration MIGRATION_4_5 = new Migration(4, 5) {
        @Override
        public void migrate(@NonNull SupportSQLiteDatabase db) {
            db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE sightings ADD COLUMN lat_new REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0");
            db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE sightings ADD COLUMN lng_new REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0");
            // Backfill data from old column, then drop it in v6
        }
    };
}
```

```/dev/null/DatabaseModule.java#L1-50
package com.silverbacksentry.core.database.di;

import android.content.Context;
import androidx.room.Room;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.DatabaseMigrations;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.SentryDatabase;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.dao.RangerDao;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.dao.SightingDao;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.dao.SightingPhotoDao;
import dagger.Module;
import dagger.Provides;
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn;
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent.class)
public final class DatabaseModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    public static SentryDatabase provideDatabase(@ApplicationContext Context context) {
        return Room.databaseBuilder(
                context,
                SentryDatabase.class,
                "sentry-database"
            )
            // Register all manual migrations here — never use destructiveMigration
            .addMigrations(
                DatabaseMigrations.MIGRATION_3_4,
                DatabaseMigrations.MIGRATION_4_5
            )
            .build();
    }

    // ── DAO providers (mirrors NowInAndroid's DaosModule) ────────────────────

    @Provides
    public static SightingDao provideSightingDao(SentryDatabase db) {
        return db.sightingDao();
    }

    @Provides
    public static RangerDao provideRangerDao(SentryDatabase db) {
        return db.rangerDao();
    }

    @Provides
    public static SightingPhotoDao provideSightingPhotoDao(SentryDatabase db) {
        return db.sightingPhotoDao();
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/NetworkSighting.java#L1-45
// core/network/model/NetworkSighting.java
package com.silverbacksentry.core.network.model;

import com.google.gson.annotations.SerializedName;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.model.SightingEntity;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.HealthStatus;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.UUID;

public class NetworkSighting {

    @SerializedName("id")          public String id;
    @SerializedName("ranger_id")   public String rangerId;
    @SerializedName("gorilla_id")  public String gorillaId;
    @SerializedName("latitude")    public double latitude;
    @SerializedName("longitude")   public double longitude;
    @SerializedName("group_size")  public int    groupSize;
    @SerializedName("health")      public String healthStatus;
    @SerializedName("notes")       public String notes;
    @SerializedName("recorded_at") public long   recordedAtMs;  // epoch millis

    /** Convert a Room entity to a network payload for upload */
    public static NetworkSighting fromEntity(SightingEntity entity) {
        NetworkSighting n    = new NetworkSighting();
        n.id           = entity.id;
        n.rangerId     = entity.rangerId;
        n.gorillaId    = entity.gorillaId;
        n.latitude     = entity.latitude;
        n.longitude    = entity.longitude;
        n.groupSize    = entity.groupSize;
        n.healthStatus = entity.healthStatus.name();
        n.notes        = entity.notes;
        n.recordedAtMs = entity.recordedAt.getTime();
        return n;
    }

    /** Convert a server response into a Room entity, marked as synced */
    public SightingEntity toEntity() {
        SightingEntity e   = new SightingEntity();
        e.id           = (id != null) ? id : UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        e.rangerId     = rangerId;
        e.gorillaId    = gorillaId;
        e.latitude     = latitude;
        e.longitude    = longitude;
        e.groupSize    = groupSize;
        e.healthStatus = HealthStatus.valueOf(healthStatus);
        e.notes        = (notes != null) ? notes : "";
        e.recordedAt   = new Date(recordedAtMs);
        e.synced       = true;
        return e;
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/NetworkModule.java#L1-65
package com.silverbacksentry.core.network.di;

import com.silverbacksentry.core.network.SentryRemoteApi;

import dagger.Provides;
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn;
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent;
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient;
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor;
import retrofit2.Retrofit;
import retrofit2.converter.gson.GsonConverterFactory;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent.class)
public final class NetworkModule {

    private static final String BASE_URL = "https://api.silverbacksentry.app/v1/";

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    public static OkHttpClient provideOkHttpClient() {
        HttpLoggingInterceptor logging = new HttpLoggingInterceptor();
        logging.setLevel(HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY);  // remove in release

        return new OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            // Add auth interceptor here if needed:
            // .addInterceptor(new AuthInterceptor(tokenProvider))
            .connectTimeout(30, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .readTimeout(30, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .build();
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    public static Retrofit provideRetrofit(OkHttpClient client) {
        return new Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl(BASE_URL)
            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(GsonConverterFactory.create())
            .build();
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    public static SentryRemoteApi provideRemoteApi(Retrofit retrofit) {
        return retrofit.create(SentryRemoteApi.class);
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/SightingRepository.java#L1-30
package com.silverbacksentry.core.data.repository;

import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;

/**
 * Q07 — The contract. The UI only ever interacts with this interface,
 * never with the DAO or the network directly.
 */
public interface SightingRepository {

    /**
     * Returns a live stream of sightings for this ranger.
     * Room emits a new list automatically after every write —
     * the UI never reads from the network response (single source of truth).
     */
    LiveData<List<Sighting>> getSightings(String rangerId);

    /** Write locally first, set synced=false; WorkManager uploads later. */
    void logSighting(Sighting sighting);

    /** Update an existing sighting — synced reset to false */
    void updateSighting(Sighting sighting);

    /** Delete a sighting by ID, scoped to the current ranger */
    void deleteSighting(String id, String rangerId);
```

### 5b. Offline-First Implementation

```/dev/null/OfflineFirstSightingRepository.java#L1-100
// core/data/repository/OfflineFirstSightingRepository.java
package com.silverbacksentry.core.data.repository;

import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
import androidx.lifecycle.Transformations;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.dao.SightingDao;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.model.SightingEntity;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.Sighting;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

/**
 * Q07 — Offline-first implementation.
 *
 * Read path:  DAO → LiveData → Repository → ViewModel → UI
 *   Room is always the single source of truth.
 *   The UI never reads from a network response.
 *
 * Write path: UI → ViewModel → Repository → DAO (immediate, offline-safe)
 *   synced = false is written. WorkManager uploads when constraints are met.
 *
 * Sync path:  WorkManager (network + battery OK)
 *   → fetches changed IDs from server change list
 *   → upserts into Room
 *   → Room LiveData emits → UI updates automatically
 */
@Singleton
public class OfflineFirstSightingRepository implements SightingRepository {

    private final SightingDao    sightingDao;
    private final ExecutorService executor;

    @Inject
    public OfflineFirstSightingRepository(SightingDao sightingDao,
                                          ExecutorService dbExecutor) {
        this.sightingDao = sightingDao;
        this.executor    = dbExecutor;
    }

    // ── READ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Override
    public LiveData<List<Sighting>> getSightings(String rangerId) {
        // Transformations.map runs on the main thread; the mapping lambda
        // is cheap (entity → domain), so this is safe.
        return Transformations.map(
            sightingDao.getSightingsForRanger(rangerId),
            entities -> {
                List<Sighting> result = new ArrayList<>(entities.size());
                for (SightingEntity e : entities) result.add(e.toDomain());
                return result;
            }
        );
    }

    // ── WRITE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // All writes go to an ExecutorService so they never block the main thread.
    // Room will emit a LiveData update automatically after each write.

    @Override
    public void logSighting(Sighting sighting) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            SightingEntity entity = SightingEntity.fromDomain(sighting);
            entity.synced = false;   // must be uploaded
            sightingDao.upsertSighting(entity);
            // Room emits → LiveData updates → UI refreshes instantly ✓
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void updateSighting(Sighting sighting) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            SightingEntity entity = SightingEntity.fromDomain(sighting);
            entity.synced = false;   // changed → needs re-upload
            sightingDao.upsertSighting(entity);
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void deleteSighting(String id, String rangerId) {
        executor.execute(() -> sightingDao.deleteSighting(id, rangerId));
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/DataModule.java#L1-60
package com.silverbacksentry.core.data.di;

import com.silverbacksentry.core.data.repository.OfflineFirstSightingRepository;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.data.repository.SightingRepository;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.data.util.ConnectivityNetworkMonitor;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.data.util.NetworkMonitor;
import dagger.Binds;
import dagger.Module;
import dagger.Provides;
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn;
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

/**
 * Mirrors NowInAndroid's DataModule.
 * @Binds wires interfaces → implementations.
 * @Provides (static) supplies non-injectable types like ExecutorService.
 * Mixed @Binds + @Provides require @Provides to be static in abstract class.
 */
@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent.class)
public abstract class DataModule {

    // ── Repository bindings ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Binds
    @Singleton
    public abstract SightingRepository bindSightingRepository(
        OfflineFirstSightingRepository impl
    );

    // ── Network monitor binding ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Binds
    @Singleton
    public abstract NetworkMonitor bindNetworkMonitor(
        ConnectivityNetworkMonitor impl
    );

    // ── ExecutorService — background thread pool for all DB writes ────────────

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    public static ExecutorService provideDbExecutor() {
        // 4 threads: enough for concurrent reads+writes without contention
        return Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4);
    }
}
```

## 6 — Feature 2: Network Monitor (`callbackFlow` → custom `LiveData`)

The most important Java translation: `callbackFlow { awaitClose {} }` becomes `LiveData.onActive()` / `onInactive()`. The lifecycle hooks do exactly the same thing — register on first observer, unregister when last observer is gone.

```/dev/null/NetworkMonitor.java#L1-12
// core/data/util/NetworkMonitor.java
package com.silverbacksentry.core.data.util;

import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.NetworkState;

public interface NetworkMonitor {
    /** Emits the current network state and re-emits on every change. */
    LiveData<NetworkState> getNetworkState();
}
```

```/dev/null/ConnectivityNetworkMonitor.java#L1-105
// core/data/util/ConnectivityNetworkMonitor.java
package com.silverbacksentry.core.data.util;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.ConnectivityManager;
import android.net.Network;
import android.net.NetworkCapabilities;
import android.net.NetworkRequest;
import android.provider.Settings;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.NetworkState;
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

/**
 * Feature 2 — Network state monitor.
 *
 * Java equivalent of NowInAndroid's callbackFlow + NetworkCallback pattern.
 *
 * How it works:
 *  onActive()   → called when the FIRST observer subscribes
 *                 → registers NetworkCallback (no polling, zero battery waste)
 *  onInactive() → called when the LAST observer unsubscribes
 *                 → unregisters callback (prevents memory leaks)
 *
 * This mirrors: callbackFlow { ... awaitClose { connectivityManager.unregisterNetworkCallback(cb) } }
 */
@Singleton
public class ConnectivityNetworkMonitor extends LiveData<NetworkState>
        implements NetworkMonitor {

    private final ConnectivityManager connectivityManager;
    private final Context appContext;
    private ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback networkCallback;

    // Track every available network — same as NowInAndroid's mutableSetOf<Network>()
    private final Set<Network> availableNetworks = new HashSet<>();

    @Inject
    public ConnectivityNetworkMonitor(@ApplicationContext Context context) {
        this.appContext           = context;
        this.connectivityManager = (ConnectivityManager)
            context.getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE);
    }

    // ── LiveData lifecycle hooks ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Override
    protected void onActive() {
        availableNetworks.clear();

        networkCallback = new ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {

            @Override
            public void onAvailable(@NonNull Network network) {
                availableNetworks.add(network);
                postValue(NetworkState.CONNECTED);
            }

            @Override
            public void onLost(@NonNull Network network) {
                availableNetworks.remove(network);
                // Still connected if other networks remain
                postValue(availableNetworks.isEmpty()
                    ? resolveIdleOrAirplane()
                    : NetworkState.CONNECTED);
            }

            @Override
            public void onCapabilitiesChanged(@NonNull Network network,
                                              @NonNull NetworkCapabilities caps) {
                // Re-evaluate when capabilities change (e.g., captive portal resolved)
                if (caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED)) {
                    postValue(NetworkState.CONNECTED);
                }
            }
        };

        NetworkRequest request = new NetworkRequest.Builder()
            .addCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET)
            .build();

        connectivityManager.registerNetworkCallback(request, networkCallback);

        // Emit immediately so observers get the current state on subscription
        postValue(getCurrentState());
    }

    @Override
    protected void onInactive() {
        // Exact Java equivalent of awaitClose { unregisterNetworkCallback(callback) }
        if (networkCallback != null) {
            connectivityManager.unregisterNetworkCallback(networkCallback);
            networkCallback = null;
        }
        availableNetworks.clear();
    }

    // ── NetworkMonitor interface ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Override
    public LiveData<NetworkState> getNetworkState() {
        return this;   // this class IS the LiveData
    }

    // ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private NetworkState getCurrentState() {
        if (isAirplaneModeOn()) return NetworkState.AIRPLANE_MODE;
        Network active = connectivityManager.getActiveNetwork();
        if (active == null) return NetworkState.IDLE;
        NetworkCapabilities caps = connectivityManager.getNetworkCapabilities(active);
        return (caps != null &&
                caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET))
            ? NetworkState.CONNECTED
            : NetworkState.IDLE;
    }

    private NetworkState resolveIdleOrAirplane() {
        return isAirplaneModeOn() ? NetworkState.AIRPLANE_MODE : NetworkState.IDLE;
    }

    private boolean isAirplaneModeOn() {
        return Settings.Global.getInt(appContext.getContentResolver(),
            Settings.Global.AIRPLANE_MODE_ON, 0) != 0;
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/SystemHardwareChecker.java#L1-115
// core/hardware/SystemHardwareChecker.java
package com.silverbacksentry.core.hardware;

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.IntentFilter;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.location.LocationManager;
import android.os.BatteryManager;
import android.provider.Settings;
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.HardwareState;
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

/**
 * Feature 1 — Hardware Diagnostic.
 * Checks only hardware relevant to a field ranger:
 *   GPS (location tracking), Camera (photo evidence),
 *   Cellular (network comms), Battery (upload gating).
 *
 * BroadcastReceiver → LiveData bridge (same pattern as ConnectivityNetworkMonitor).
 */
@Singleton
public class SystemHardwareChecker extends LiveData<HardwareState>
        implements HardwareChecker {

    private final Context appContext;
    private BroadcastReceiver batteryReceiver;

    @Inject
    public SystemHardwareChecker(@ApplicationContext Context context) {
        this.appContext = context.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActive() {
        batteryReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
            @Override
            public void onReceive(Context ctx, Intent intent) {
                postValue(buildState());
            }
        };

        IntentFilter filter = new IntentFilter();
        filter.addAction(Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED);
        filter.addAction(Intent.ACTION_AIRPLANE_MODE_CHANGED);
        filter.addAction(LocationManager.PROVIDERS_CHANGED_ACTION);

        appContext.registerReceiver(batteryReceiver, filter);
        postValue(buildState());   // emit current state immediately
    }

    @Override
    protected void onInactive() {
        if (batteryReceiver != null) {
            appContext.unregisterReceiver(batteryReceiver);
            batteryReceiver = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public LiveData<HardwareState> getHardwareState() {
        return this;
    }

    // ── Hardware inspection ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private HardwareState buildState() {

        // Battery level
        Intent battStatus = appContext.registerReceiver(
            null, new IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED));
        int level = (battStatus != null)
            ? battStatus.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_LEVEL, -1) : -1;
        int scale = (battStatus != null)
            ? battStatus.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_SCALE, -1) : -1;
        int batteryPercent = (scale > 0) ? (level * 100 / scale) : 0;
        boolean isBatteryLow = (batteryPercent < 20);

        // GPS
        LocationManager lm = (LocationManager)
            appContext.getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE);
        boolean hasGps = (lm != null)
            && lm.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER);

        // Camera — any camera hardware present
        boolean hasCamera = appContext.getPackageManager()
            .hasSystemFeature(PackageManager.FEATURE_CAMERA_ANY);

        // Cellular radio (GSM, CDMA, LTE)
        TelephonyManager tm = (TelephonyManager)
            appContext.getSystemService(Context.TELEPHONY_SERVICE);
        boolean hasCellular = (tm != null)
            && (tm.getPhoneType() != TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_NONE);

        // Airplane mode
        boolean airplaneOn = Settings.Global.getInt(
            appContext.getContentResolver(),
            Settings.Global.AIRPLANE_MODE_ON, 0) != 0;

        return new HardwareState(hasCellular, hasGps, hasCamera,
                                 isBatteryLow, batteryPercent, airplaneOn);
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/SystemTrayNotifier.java#L1-130
// core/notifications/SystemTrayNotifier.java
package com.silverbacksentry.core.notifications;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.os.Build;
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat;
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat;
import androidx.core.app.NotificationManagerCompat;
import com.silverbacksentry.app.MainActivity;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.notifications.R;
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

@Singleton
public class SystemTrayNotifier implements Notifier {

    private static final String UPLOAD_CHANNEL_ID   = "upload_channel";
    private static final String ALERT_CHANNEL_ID    = "alert_channel";
    private static final int    UPLOAD_NOTIF_ID     = 1001;
    private static final int    ALERT_NOTIF_ID      = 1002;
    private static final int    ERROR_NOTIF_ID      = 1003;

    private final Context context;

    @Inject
    public SystemTrayNotifier(@ApplicationContext Context context) {
        this.context = context;
        ensureChannelsExist();
    }

    // ── Notifier impl ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Override
    public void postUploadSuccess(int recordCount) {
        if (!hasPermission()) return;
        Notification n = new NotificationCompat.Builder(context, UPLOAD_CHANNEL_ID)
            .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_gorilla)
            .setContentTitle("Sync Complete")
            .setContentText(recordCount + " sightings uploaded successfully.")
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .build();
        NotificationManagerCompat.from(context).notify(UPLOAD_NOTIF_ID, n);
    }

    @Override
    public void postConservationAlert(String title, String body) {
        if (!hasPermission()) return;
        // High-priority alert — launches MainActivity on tap
        PendingIntent tapIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            context, 0,
            new Intent(context, MainActivity.class),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        );
        Notification n = new NotificationCompat.Builder(context, ALERT_CHANNEL_ID)
            .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_alert)
            .setContentTitle(title)
            .setContentText(body)
            .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_HIGH)
            .setContentIntent(tapIntent)
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .build();
        NotificationManagerCompat.from(context).notify(ALERT_NOTIF_ID, n);
    }

    @Override
    public void postSyncError(String reason) {
        if (!hasPermission()) return;
        Notification n = new NotificationCompat.Builder(context, UPLOAD_CHANNEL_ID)
            .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_warning)
            .setContentTitle("Upload Failed")
            .setContentText(reason)
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .build();
        NotificationManagerCompat.from(context).notify(ERROR_NOTIF_ID, n);
    }

    // ── Channel creation (required on Android 8+) ────────────────────────────

    private void ensureChannelsExist() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return;

        NotificationManager nm =
            (NotificationManager) context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);

        nm.createNotificationChannel(new NotificationChannel(
            UPLOAD_CHANNEL_ID, "Sync Status", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT));

        NotificationChannel alertChannel = new NotificationChannel(
            ALERT_CHANNEL_ID, "Conservation Alerts", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_HIGH);
        alertChannel.setDescription("Urgent alerts from the conservation team.");
        nm.createNotificationChannel(alertChannel);
    }

    private boolean hasPermission() {
        return Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU
            || ActivityCompat.checkSelfPermission(context,
               Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/SentryMessagingService.java#L1-75
// sync/work/services/SentryMessagingService.java
package com.silverbacksentry.sync.services;

import android.util.Log;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import com.google.firebase.messaging.FirebaseMessagingService;
import com.google.firebase.messaging.RemoteMessage;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.notifications.Notifier;
import com.silverbacksentry.sync.work.UploadManager;
import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint;
import java.util.Map;
import javax.inject.Inject;

/**
 * Feature 3 — FCM service.
 * Mirrors NowInAndroid's SyncNotificationsService exactly.
 *
 * Two incoming topics:
 *  /topics/sync    → server signals new data available → trigger download sync
 *  /topics/alerts  → server sends a conservation alert → show notification
 *
 * This service runs even when the app is completely closed.
 * It delegates to WorkManager (not coroutines) for any heavy lifting.
 */
@AndroidEntryPoint
public class SentryMessagingService extends FirebaseMessagingService {

    private static final String TAG = "SentryFCM";

    // NowInAndroid pattern: inject SyncManager and delegate
    @Inject UploadManager uploadManager;
    @Inject Notifier      notifier;

    private static final String SYNC_TOPIC   = "/topics/sync";
    private static final String ALERTS_TOPIC = "/topics/alerts";

    @Override
    public void onMessageReceived(@NonNull RemoteMessage message) {
        Log.d(TAG, "FCM from: " + message.getFrom());

        if (SYNC_TOPIC.equals(message.getFrom())) {
            // Server signals data has changed — enqueue WorkManager download sync
            uploadManager.requestSync();
            return;
        }

        if (ALERTS_TOPIC.equals(message.getFrom())) {
            Map<String, String> data = message.getData();
            String title = data.containsKey("title") ? data.get("title") : "Conservation Alert";
            String body  = data.containsKey("body")  ? data.get("body")  : "";
            // Post a high-priority system notification immediately
            notifier.postConservationAlert(title, body);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onNewToken(@NonNull String token) {
        // Send the refreshed FCM token to your server
        Log.d(TAG, "New FCM token: " + token);
        // uploadManager.updateFcmToken(token);
    }
}
```

## 9 — Q02: WorkManager Upload Chain

### 9a. Upload Worker

```/dev/null/SightingUploadWorker.java#L1-130
// sync/work/workers/SightingUploadWorker.java
package com.silverbacksentry.sync.workers;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.Log;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.work.Constraints;
import androidx.work.NetworkType;
import androidx.work.OneTimeWorkRequest;
import androidx.work.OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder;
import androidx.work.WorkManager;
import androidx.work.Worker;
import androidx.work.WorkerParameters;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.dao.SightingDao;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.database.model.SightingEntity;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.network.SentryRemoteApi;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.network.model.NetworkSighting;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.notifications.Notifier;
import com.silverbacksentry.sync.session.RangerSession;
import dagger.hilt.EntryPoint;
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn;
import dagger.hilt.android.EntryPointAccessors;
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import retrofit2.Response;

/**
 * Q02 — WorkManager upload chain.
 *
 * Constraints:
 *   - CONNECTED network (any internet)
 *   - Battery NOT low (> ~20 %)
 *
 * Batch strategy: 50 records per HTTP call.
 *   Each batch is marked synced immediately after the server ACKs it.
 *   If a batch fails mid-way, only the failed batches remain synced=false.
 *   Result.retry() triggers exponential backoff — WorkManager restarts the
 *   entire worker, but skips already-synced records since getUnsyncedSightingsSync
 *   only returns synced=false records.
 *
 * Hilt injection uses the @EntryPoint pattern (simpler than @AssistedInject in Java).
 */
public class SightingUploadWorker extends Worker {

    private static final String TAG        = "SightingUploadWorker";
    private static final int    BATCH_SIZE = 50;
    private static final String WORK_NAME  = "SightingUpload";

    // ── Hilt EntryPoint (mirrors NowInAndroid's DelegatingWorker approach) ───

    @EntryPoint
    @InstallIn(SingletonComponent.class)
    interface UploadWorkerEntryPoint {
        SightingDao    sightingDao();
        SentryRemoteApi remoteApi();
        RangerSession  rangerSession();
        Notifier       notifier();
    }

    private final SightingDao    sightingDao;
    private final SentryRemoteApi remoteApi;
    private final RangerSession  rangerSession;
    private final Notifier       notifier;

    public SightingUploadWorker(@NonNull Context context,
                                @NonNull WorkerParameters params) {
        super(context, params);
        UploadWorkerEntryPoint ep = EntryPointAccessors.fromApplication(
            context.getApplicationContext(), UploadWorkerEntryPoint.class);
        this.sightingDao  = ep.sightingDao();
        this.remoteApi    = ep.remoteApi();
        this.rangerSession = ep.rangerSession();
        this.notifier     = ep.notifier();
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public Result doWork() {
        String rangerId = rangerSession.getCurrentRangerId();
        if (rangerId == null) {
            Log.w(TAG, "No active ranger — skipping upload");
            return Result.failure();
        }

        List<SightingEntity> unsynced = sightingDao.getUnsyncedSightingsSync(rangerId);
        if (unsynced.isEmpty()) return Result.success();

        Log.d(TAG, "Uploading " + unsynced.size() + " sightings in batches of " + BATCH_SIZE);

        boolean allSucceeded = true;
        int totalUploaded = 0;

        // ── Batch loop ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        for (int i = 0; i < unsynced.size(); i += BATCH_SIZE) {
            List<SightingEntity> batch =
                unsynced.subList(i, Math.min(i + BATCH_SIZE, unsynced.size()));

            // Build network payload
            List<NetworkSighting> payload = new ArrayList<>();
            for (SightingEntity e : batch) payload.add(NetworkSighting.fromEntity(e));

            try {
                Response<Void> response = remoteApi.uploadSightings(payload).execute();

                if (response.isSuccessful()) {
                    // Mark ONLY this batch — partial failure leaves others untouched
                    List<String> ids = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (SightingEntity e : batch) ids.add(e.id);
                    sightingDao.markAsSynced(ids);
                    totalUploaded += batch.size();
                    Log.d(TAG, "Batch " + (i / BATCH_SIZE + 1) + " OK");
                } else {
                    sightingDao.incrementSyncAttempt(getIds(batch));
                    allSucceeded = false;
                    Log.w(TAG, "Batch failed: HTTP " + response.code());
                }
            } catch (IOException e) {
                sightingDao.incrementSyncAttempt(getIds(batch));
                allSucceeded = false;
                Log.e(TAG, "Network error on batch", e);
            }
        }

        if (allSucceeded) {
            notifier.postUploadSuccess(totalUploaded);
            return Result.success();
        } else {
            notifier.postSyncError("Some sightings could not be uploaded. Will retry.");
            return Result.retry();   // WorkManager applies exponential backoff
        }
    }

    private List<String> getIds(List<SightingEntity> batch) {
        List<String> ids = new ArrayList<>();
        for (SightingEntity e : batch) ids.add(e.id);
        return ids;
    }

    // ── Work request factory (mirrors NowInAndroid's startUpSyncWork()) ───────

    public static OneTimeWorkRequest buildRequest() {
        Constraints constraints = new Constraints.Builder()
            .setRequiredNetworkType(NetworkType.CONNECTED)
            .setRequiresBatteryNotLow(true)       // battery > ~20 %
            .build();

        return new OneTimeWorkRequest.Builder(SightingUploadWorker.class)
            .setConstraints(constraints)
            .setBackoffCriteria(
                androidx.work.BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL,
                30, TimeUnit.SECONDS               // doubles on each retry
            )
            .build();
    }
}
```

### 9b. Upload Manager (`SyncManager` equivalent)

```/dev/null/UploadManager.java#L1-70
// sync/work/UploadManager.java
package com.silverbacksentry.sync.work;

import android.content.Context;
import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
import androidx.lifecycle.Transformations;
import androidx.work.ExistingWorkPolicy;
import androidx.work.WorkInfo;
import androidx.work.WorkManager;
import com.silverbacksentry.sync.workers.SightingUploadWorker;
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
import java.util.List;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

/**
 * Mirrors NowInAndroid's WorkManagerSyncManager.
 * Exposes:
 *  - isUploading LiveData<Boolean> — UI can show a progress indicator
 *  - requestSync() / requestUpload() — enqueues a unique WorkManager job
 */
@Singleton
public class UploadManager {

    private static final String UPLOAD_WORK_NAME = "SightingUploadWork";
    private static final String SYNC_WORK_NAME   = "SightingDownloadSync";

    private final WorkManager workManager;

    @Inject
    public UploadManager(@ApplicationContext Context context) {
        this.workManager = WorkManager.getInstance(context);
    }

    // ── Status LiveData ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public LiveData<Boolean> isUploading() {
        return Transformations.map(
            workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWorkLiveData(UPLOAD_WORK_NAME),
            workInfos -> {
                for (WorkInfo info : workInfos) {
                    if (info.getState() == WorkInfo.State.RUNNING) return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
        );
    }

    // ── Enqueue operations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Enqueues an upload job. KEEP policy: if one is already queued or running,
     * the new request is dropped — no duplicate jobs (same as NowInAndroid).
     */
    public void requestUpload() {
        workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(
            UPLOAD_WORK_NAME,
            ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP,            // mirrors ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP
            SightingUploadWorker.buildRequest()
        );
    }

    /**
     * Called by FCM service when server signals new data is available.
     * Triggers a download sync (pull from server → Room).
     */
    public void requestSync() {
        workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(
            SYNC_WORK_NAME,
            ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP,
            SightingDownloadSyncWorker.buildRequest()
        );
    }
}
```

## 10 — Q08: Connectivity → Auto-Upload Trigger

```/dev/null/ConnectivityUploadTrigger.java#L1-75
// core/data/util/ConnectivityUploadTrigger.java
package com.silverbacksentry.core.data.util;

import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import androidx.lifecycle.Observer;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.NetworkState;
import com.silverbacksentry.sync.work.UploadManager;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

/**
 * Q08 — Auto-upload on connectivity recovery.
 *
 * Pattern: observe NetworkMonitor LiveData on the main thread.
 * When the state transitions to CONNECTED, enqueue a WorkManager upload.
 *
 * Zero polling — purely event-driven via the network callback.
 * The LiveData observer is registered once for the application lifetime.
 * It is removed in shutdown(), called from Application.onTerminate().
 *
 * This mirrors NowInAndroid's approach of calling syncManager.requestSync()
 * inside the callbackFlow collection on network availability.
 */
@Singleton
public class ConnectivityUploadTrigger {

    private final NetworkMonitor   networkMonitor;
    private final UploadManager    uploadManager;
    private final Handler          mainHandler;

    // Track the last known state to detect IDLE → CONNECTED transitions only
    private NetworkState lastState = NetworkState.IDLE;
    private Observer<NetworkState> observer;

    @Inject
    public ConnectivityUploadTrigger(NetworkMonitor networkMonitor,
                                     UploadManager uploadManager) {
        this.networkMonitor = networkMonitor;
        this.uploadManager  = uploadManager;
        this.mainHandler    = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    }

    /**
     * Call once from Application.onCreate().
     * Registers a forever-observer on the network state LiveData.
     */
    public void initialize() {
        observer = state -> {
            // Only trigger on the transition from a non-connected state → CONNECTED
            if (state == NetworkState.CONNECTED && lastState != NetworkState.CONNECTED) {
                android.util.Log.d("ConnTrigger", "Back online — enqueuing upload");
                uploadManager.requestUpload();
            }
            lastState = state;
        };

        // observeForever: no LifecycleOwner — lives for the entire app lifetime
        // Safe here because we unregister in shutdown()
        mainHandler.post(() ->
            networkMonitor.getNetworkState().observeForever(observer)
        );
    }

    /**
     * Call from Application.onTerminate() to clean up the forever-observer.
     */
    public void shutdown() {
        if (observer != null) {
            networkMonitor.getNetworkState().removeObserver(observer);
            observer = null;
        }
    }
}
```

## 11 — Q09: Multi-Ranger Session (Data Isolation)

```/dev/null/RangerSession.java#L1-85
// sync/session/RangerSession.java
package com.silverbacksentry.sync.session;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
import androidx.lifecycle.MutableLiveData;
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

/**
 * Q09 — Single source of truth for "which ranger is logged in."
 *
 * All repository and DAO calls must obtain the rangerId from here —
 * never from user input or a ViewModel field that could be spoofed.
 *
 * SharedPreferences survives app restart (unlike in-memory state).
 * MutableLiveData lets the UI and repositories observe the session reactively.
 */
@Singleton
public class RangerSession {

    private static final String PREF_NAME      = "ranger_session";
    private static final String KEY_RANGER_ID  = "active_ranger_id";
    private static final String KEY_USERNAME   = "active_username";

    private final SharedPreferences prefs;
    private final MutableLiveData<String> currentRangerIdLive = new MutableLiveData<>();

    @Inject
    public RangerSession(@ApplicationContext Context context) {
        this.prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREF_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        // Restore session from last run
        String savedId = prefs.getString(KEY_RANGER_ID, null);
        currentRangerIdLive.setValue(savedId);
    }

    // ── Reads ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Synchronous read — safe to call from Worker.doWork() (background thread).
     */
    public String getCurrentRangerId() {
        return prefs.getString(KEY_RANGER_ID, null);
    }

    public String getCurrentUsername() {
        return prefs.getString(KEY_USERNAME, null);
    }

    /** Observable — UI components use this to react to login/logout */
    public LiveData<String> getCurrentRangerIdLive() {
        return currentRangerIdLive;
    }

    public boolean isLoggedIn() {
        return getCurrentRangerId() != null;
    }

    // ── Mutations ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public void login(String rangerId, String username) {
        prefs.edit()
            .putString(KEY_RANGER_ID, rangerId)
            .putString(KEY_USERNAME,  username)
            .apply();                                  // async write, never commit()
        currentRangerIdLive.postValue(rangerId);
    }

    public void logout() {
        prefs.edit()
            .remove(KEY_RANGER_ID)
            .remove(KEY_USERNAME)
            .apply();
        currentRangerIdLive.postValue(null);
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/FileStorageManager.java#L1-45
// core/data/util/FileStorageManager.java  — Q09 per-ranger file isolation
package com.silverbacksentry.core.data.util;

import android.content.Context;
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
import java.io.File;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

/**
 * Q09 — Per-ranger file storage.
 * Paths: filesDir/photos/{rangerId}/{filename}
 * Each ranger's photos are invisible to other rangers.
 */
@Singleton
public class FileStorageManager {

    private final Context context;

    @Inject
    public FileStorageManager(@ApplicationContext Context context) {
        this.context = context;
    }

    public File getRangerPhotoDir(String rangerId) {
        File dir = new File(context.getFilesDir(), "photos/" + rangerId);
        if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs();
        return dir;
    }

    public File newPhotoFile(String rangerId, String sightingId) {
        String filename = sightingId + "_" + System.currentTimeMillis() + ".jpg";
        return new File(getRangerPhotoDir(rangerId), filename);
    }

    /** Delete all files when a ranger account is removed from the device */
    public void deleteRangerFiles(String rangerId) {
        File dir = new File(context.getFilesDir(), "photos/" + rangerId);
        deleteRecursively(dir);
    }

    private void deleteRecursively(File file) {
        if (file.isDirectory()) {
            for (File child : file.listFiles()) deleteRecursively(child);
        }
        file.delete();
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/SightingListViewModel.java#L1-85
// feature/sightings/SightingListViewModel.java
package com.silverbacksentry.feature.sightings;

import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
import androidx.lifecycle.MediatorLiveData;
import androidx.lifecycle.MutableLiveData;
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.data.repository.SightingRepository;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.Sighting;
import com.silverbacksentry.sync.session.RangerSession;
import com.silverbacksentry.sync.work.UploadManager;
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel;
import java.util.List;
import javax.inject.Inject;

/**
 * Java equivalent of NowInAndroid's ForYouViewModel.
 *
 * Uses MediatorLiveData to switch the sightings source whenever
 * the logged-in ranger changes — mirrors Kotlin's switchMap / flatMapLatest.
 */
@HiltViewModel
public class SightingListViewModel extends ViewModel {

    private final SightingRepository repository;
    private final RangerSession      rangerSession;
    private final UploadManager      uploadManager;

    // ── Exposed state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    // MediatorLiveData: switches its source based on the active rangerId
    private final MediatorLiveData<List<Sighting>> sightingsMediatorLive
        = new MediatorLiveData<>();

    // Tracks the current active source so we can remove it before adding a new one
    private LiveData<List<Sighting>> activeSightingsSource = null;

    public final LiveData<List<Sighting>> sightings        = sightingsMediatorLive;
    public final LiveData<Boolean>        isUploading;
    public final LiveData<String>         currentRangerId;

    @Inject
    public SightingListViewModel(SightingRepository repository,
                                 RangerSession rangerSession,
                                 UploadManager uploadManager) {
        this.repository    = repository;
        this.rangerSession = rangerSession;
        this.uploadManager = uploadManager;

        isUploading     = uploadManager.isUploading();
        currentRangerId = rangerSession.getCurrentRangerIdLive();

        // Observe ranger ID changes and switch the data source accordingly
        // Java equivalent of Flow.flatMapLatest / Transformations.switchMap
        sightingsMediatorLive.addSource(
            rangerSession.getCurrentRangerIdLive(),
            rangerId -> {
                // Remove the old source to avoid duplicate emissions
                if (activeSightingsSource != null) {
                    sightingsMediatorLive.removeSource(activeSightingsSource);
                }
                if (rangerId == null) {
                    sightingsMediatorLive.setValue(java.util.Collections.emptyList());
                    activeSightingsSource = null;
                    return;
                }
                activeSightingsSource = repository.getSightings(rangerId);
                sightingsMediatorLive.addSource(
                    activeSightingsSource,
                    sightingsMediatorLive::setValue
                );
            }
        );
    }

    public void deleteSighting(String sightingId) {
        String rangerId = rangerSession.getCurrentRangerId();
        if (rangerId == null) return;
        repository.deleteSighting(sightingId, rangerId);
    }

    public void triggerManualUpload() {
        uploadManager.requestUpload();
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/SightingLogViewModel.java#L1-80
// feature/sightings/SightingLogViewModel.java
package com.silverbacksentry.feature.sightings;

import androidx.lifecycle.MutableLiveData;
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.data.repository.SightingRepository;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.HealthStatus;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.Sighting;
import com.silverbacksentry.sync.session.RangerSession;
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.UUID;
import javax.inject.Inject;

/** ViewModel for the sighting log form screen */
@HiltViewModel
public class SightingLogViewModel extends ViewModel {

    private final SightingRepository repository;
    private final RangerSession      rangerSession;

    // ── Form state — each field is its own MutableLiveData ────────────────────
    public final MutableLiveData<Integer>      groupSize     = new MutableLiveData<>(1);
    public final MutableLiveData<HealthStatus> healthStatus  = new MutableLiveData<>(HealthStatus.UNKNOWN);
    public final MutableLiveData<Double>       latitude      = new MutableLiveData<>(0.0);
    public final MutableLiveData<Double>       longitude     = new MutableLiveData<>(0.0);
    public final MutableLiveData<String>       notes         = new MutableLiveData<>("");
    public final MutableLiveData<Boolean>      isSaving      = new MutableLiveData<>(false);
    public final MutableLiveData<Boolean>      saveSuccess   = new MutableLiveData<>(false);

    @Inject
    public SightingLogViewModel(SightingRepository repository, RangerSession rangerSession) {
        this.repository    = repository;
        this.rangerSession = rangerSession;
    }

    public void setLocation(double lat, double lng) {
        latitude.setValue(lat);
        longitude.setValue(lng);
    }

    public void saveSighting() {
        String rangerId = rangerSession.getCurrentRangerId();
        if (rangerId == null) return;

        isSaving.setValue(true);

        Sighting sighting = new Sighting(
            UUID.randomUUID().toString(),       // UUID generated here — idempotent uploads
            rangerId,
            null,                               // gorillaId — unknown individual
            latitude.getValue() != null  ? latitude.getValue()  : 0.0,
            longitude.getValue() != null ? longitude.getValue() : 0.0,
            groupSize.getValue() != null ? groupSize.getValue() : 1,
            healthStatus.getValue() != null ? healthStatus.getValue() : HealthStatus.UNKNOWN,
            notes.getValue() != null ? notes.getValue() : "",
            new Date(),
            false                               // synced = false — needs upload
        );

        repository.logSighting(sighting);       // non-blocking (ExecutorService)

        isSaving.setValue(false);
        saveSuccess.setValue(true);
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/MapViewModel.java#L1-55
package com.silverbacksentry.feature.map;

import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
import androidx.lifecycle.MediatorLiveData;
import androidx.lifecycle.Transformations;
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.data.repository.SightingRepository;

import java.util.List;

@HiltViewModel
public class MapViewModel extends ViewModel {

    public final LiveData<List<Sighting>> sightings;

    @Inject
    public MapViewModel(SightingRepository repository, RangerSession rangerSession) {
        // Switch to the correct ranger's sightings automatically
        sightings = Transformations.switchMap(
            rangerSession.getCurrentRangerIdLive(),
            rangerId -> (rangerId != null)
                ? repository.getSightings(rangerId)
                : new MutableLiveData<>(Collections.emptyList())
        );
    }
}
```

```/dev/null/MapFragment.java#L1-100
// feature/map/MapFragment.java
package com.silverbacksentry.feature.map;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelProvider;
import com.silverbacksentry.core.model.Sighting;
import org.maplibre.android.MapLibre;
import org.maplibre.android.camera.CameraPosition;
import org.maplibre.android.geometry.LatLng;
import org.maplibre.android.maps.MapLibreMap;
import org.maplibre.android.maps.MapView;
import org.maplibre.android.maps.OnMapReadyCallback;
import org.maplibre.android.maps.Style;
import org.maplibre.android.plugins.annotation.SymbolManager;
import org.maplibre.android.plugins.annotation.SymbolOptions;
import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Feature 4 — MapLibre interactive map.
 * Observes MapViewModel LiveData and re-plots markers when sightings change.
 * MapView lifecycle mirrors the Fragment lifecycle — must forward all events.
 */
@AndroidEntryPoint
public class MapFragment extends Fragment implements OnMapReadyCallback {

    private MapView       mapView;
    private MapLibreMap   mapLibreMap;
    private SymbolManager symbolManager;
    private MapViewModel  viewModel;

    private static final String MAP_STYLE = "https://demotiles.maplibre.org/style.json";

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater,
                             @Nullable ViewGroup container,
                             @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        MapLibre.getInstance(requireContext());
        mapView = new MapView(requireContext());
        mapView.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        mapView.getMapAsync(this);
        return mapView;
    }

    @Override
    public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
        viewModel = new ViewModelProvider(this).get(MapViewModel.class);
    }

    @Override
    public void onMapReady(@NonNull MapLibreMap map) {
        this.mapLibreMap = map;
        map.setStyle(MAP_STYLE, style -> {
            symbolManager = new SymbolManager(mapView, map, style);
            symbolManager.setIconAllowOverlap(true);

            // Centre map on Bwindi Impenetrable Forest, Uganda
            map.setCameraPosition(new CameraPosition.Builder()
                .target(new LatLng(-1.0333, 29.6167))
                .zoom(10)
                .build());

            // Now safe to observe sightings — map is ready
            viewModel.sightings.observe(getViewLifecycleOwner(),
                this::plotSightings);
        });
    }

    private void plotSightings(List<Sighting> sightings) {
        if (symbolManager == null) return;
        symbolManager.deleteAll();

        for (Sighting s : sightings) {
            symbolManager.create(new SymbolOptions()
                .withLatLng(new LatLng(s.latitude, s.longitude))
                .withIconImage("gorilla-marker")   // pre-loaded in the map style
                .withTextField(s.groupSize + " gorillas")
                .withTextSize(12f)
            );
        }
    }

    // ── MapView lifecycle forwarding (REQUIRED by MapLibre) ─────────────────

    @Override public void onStart()   { super.onStart();   mapView.onStart();   }
    @Override public void onResume()  { super.onResume();  mapView.onResume();  }
    @Override public void onPause()   { super.onPause();   mapView.onPause();   }
    @Override public void onStop()    { super.onStop();    mapView.onStop();    }
    @Override public void onDestroy() { super.onDestroy(); mapView.onDestroy(); }

    @Override
    public void onSaveInstanceState(@NonNull Bundle outState) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        mapView.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
    }

    @Override
    public void onLowMemory() {
        super.onLowMemory();
        mapView.onLowMemory();
    }
}
```

## 14 — Feature 5: Lifecycle Controller

```/dev/null/SentryLifecycleObserver.java#L1-60
// app/lifecycle/SentryLifecycleObserver.java
package com.silverbacksentry.app.lifecycle;

import androidx.lifecycle.DefaultLifecycleObserver;
import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner;
import com.silverbacksentry.sync.work.UploadManager;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Singleton;

/**
 * Feature 5 — Lifecycle Controller.
 * Registered in MainActivity.onCreate() via:
 *     getLifecycle().addObserver(sentryLifecycleObserver);
 *
 * DefaultLifecycleObserver lets us override only the methods we need.
 */
@Singleton
public class SentryLifecycleObserver implements DefaultLifecycleObserver {

    private final UploadManager uploadManager;

    @Inject
    public SentryLifecycleObserver(UploadManager uploadManager) {
        this.uploadManager = uploadManager;
    }

    @Override
    public void onResume(LifecycleOwner owner) {
        // App comes to foreground — nothing to start eagerly
        // (WorkManager + LiveData handle themselves)
    }

    @Override
    public void onPause(LifecycleOwner owner) {
        // App goes to background — trigger upload attempt
        // WorkManager constraints (network + battery) gate the actual work
        uploadManager.requestUpload();
    }

    @Override
    public void onStop(LifecycleOwner owner) {
        // Deeper background — ensure upload is queued before process might die
        uploadManager.requestUpload();
    }
}
```
